subject.title: feat: add linux/riscv64 Docker image to multi-platform build

question: Should OpenClaw officially publish a best-effort standalone riscv64 Docker tag built through QEMU and an architecture-specific runtime path?
rationale: This is a release-support and artifact-provenance commitment, not only a mechanical workflow change; current `main` has no established riscv64 image contract.

options.title: Sponsor standalone riscv64 tags
options.body: Review and land the active PR only if its isolated tag, alternate runtime provenance, non-blocking behavior, and release validation are acceptable.

options.title: Defer official riscv64 images
options.body: Keep the existing amd64/arm64 release boundary until OpenClaw can support riscv64 with an approved base-image and long-term validation policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor standalone riscv64 tags
recommendation.body: Review and land the active PR only if its isolated tag, alternate runtime provenance, non-blocking behavior, and release validation are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Docker release and attestation history makes this person the strongest routing candidate for the release-boundary decision.
